org.mobsimlab.aerial-lift.Gondolas and aerial tramways: click stat: Ama-gondola nezimoto zentambo eziya ziphindela: chofoza iziteshi, imibhoshongo iyalandela.
org.mobsimlab.aerial-lift.Urban ropeways: continuous gondolas (MGD: Izimoto zentambo zasedolobheni: ama-gondola ahamba ngaphandle kokuma (MGD, 2S, 3S, funitel, ahamba ngamaqembu) nezimoto zentambo eziya ziphindela, ezidwetshwa ngethuluzi lezikhala eziqondile (ADR-0037).

org.mobsimlab.cargo-bike.How far an electric cargo tricycle gets: Ukuthi ibhayisikili lempahla elinamasondo amathathu likagesi lingaya libuye kude kangakanani ngokushaja ibhethri kanye, emagqumeni futhi likhetha imizila yamabhayisikili, nokuthi longa malini uma liqhathaniswa nemoto (ukuthenga, uphethiloli, intela, umshwalense, ukupaka, ukulungisa), kuthebhu yalo.
org.mobsimlab.cargo-bike.Round trip from a start point to a desti: Uhambo lokuya nokubuya kusuka endaweni yokuqala kuya lapho uya khona emigwaqweni esebenziseka ngebhayisikili (likhetha imizila yamabhayisikili) nebhethri elisetshenziswe ezweni, kanye nemephu yebanga ebonisa ukuthi ibhayisikili lingaya libuye kude kangakanani kuzo zonke izinhlangothi.
org.mobsimlab.cargo-bike.Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a: Izindleko zonyaka zebhayisikili lempahla uma ziqhathaniswa nemoto ohambweni olufanayo: ukuthenga, amandla, intela, umshwalense, ukupaka nokulungisa, ngemali yezwe lendawo yokuqala.

org.mobsimlab.energy.Electricity, diesel, final energy and CO: Ugesi, udizili, amandla okugcina ne-CO2e ngonyaka kulayini ngamunye, ohlotsheni ngalunye lwezokuthutha nakunethiwekhi yonke, kanye nobukhulu nge-km yemoto ngayinye nange-km yesihlalo ngasinye.
org.mobsimlab.energy.Traction energy and greenhouse gas emiss: Amandla okudonsa nokukhishwa kwamagesi abamba ukushisa kwelayini ngalinye ngonyaka, ohlotsheni ngalunye lwezokuthutha nakunethiwekhi, kusuka kuma-km ezimoto ahanjwa yilayini ngalinye: ugesi esiteshini esincane noma kushaja, udizili ngamalitha, ne-CO2e kusuka ebukhulwini bokukhishwa kwegridi nodizili kusuka emthonjeni kuya esondweni. Kuboniswa kuthebhu Amatafula.

org.mobsimlab.esri-imagery.Aerial photos at about 0.3 to 1 m per pi: Izithombe zasemoyeni ezicishe zibe ngamamitha angu-0.3 kuya ku-1 nge-pixel emadolobheni amaningi, ezingacacile kangako emaphandleni: zicace ngokwanele ukubona imizila, imiphetho yemigwaqo nojantshi. Izinsuku zezithombe ziyehluka ngokwendawo.
org.mobsimlab.esri-imagery.Esri World Imagery as an aerial basemap:: I-Esri World Imagery njengemephu eyisisekelo yasemoyeni: izithombe zasemoyeni ezicishe zibe ngamamitha angu-0.3 kuya ku-1 nge-pixel emadolobheni amaningi, ezicace ngokwanele ukubona imizila, imiphetho yemigwaqo nojantshi. Inikezwa uma uMphathi esegcine ukhiye we-ArcGIS API futhi wamukela imigomo ye-Esri ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuphatha → Ama-plugin; amathayela adlula kule MobSimLab, ngakho iziphequluli azilokothi zibone ukhiye, futhi awagcinwa.

org.mobsimlab.ferry.Passenger ferries and water buses drawn: Izikebhe zabagibeli namabhasi asemanzini adwetshwa ngethuluzi lomzila wasemanzini: amachweba anezindawo zokumisa namabhuloho okugibela, imizila phezu kwamanzi, izindawo zesivinini nokuhlolwa kwezindawo zokumisa (ADR-0037). Izikebhe zezimoto zizofika kamuva.
org.mobsimlab.ferry.Water buses and crossings: click piers,: Amabhasi asemanzini nokuwela: chofoza amachweba, wakhe umzila phezu kwamanzi.

org.mobsimlab.gtfs.Reads a GTFS feed (zip) into the project: Ifunda okuphakelwayo kwe-GTFS (zip) kuphrojekthi njengenethiwekhi ekhona yosuku olulodwa lwesevisi, enqunywe ekubukeni kwemephu uma kucelwe, ukuze umhleli wohambo ayisebenzise kanye nemigqa ehleliwe; futhi ibhala imigqa yephrojekthi njengokuphakelwayo kwe-GTFS kwamanye amathuluzi.
org.mobsimlab.gtfs.Stops, routes and the trips of one servi: Izitobhi, imizila nohambo losuku olulodwa lwesevisi (uLwesithathu olumatasa kakhulu ngaphandle uma kunikezwe usuku), ne-frequencies.txt njengamaphethini emvamisa nezinhlobo zemizila njengezinhlobo zokuthutha.
org.mobsimlab.gtfs.The project's lines as a weekday GTFS fe: Imigqa yephrojekthi njengokuphakelwayo kwe-GTFS kosuku lokusebenza: uhambo oluqondile, imigqa yemvamisa njenge-frequencies.txt, iziteshi zamaqembu ezitobhi.

org.mobsimlab.nasa-gibs.About 30 m per pixel (38 m on this map),: Cishe amamitha angu-30 nge-pixel (amamitha angu-38 kule mephu), kusuka ekudluleni kwesathelayithi kosuku olulodwa: izingxenye zemephu azinalutho noma zinamafu, ngakho zama olunye usuku. Azicacile ngokwanele ukudweba ujantshi noma imiphetho yemigwaqo.
org.mobsimlab.nasa-gibs.Satellite imagery from NASA's Global Ima: Izithombe zesathelayithi ezivela ku-Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) ye-NASA njengamamephu ayisisekelo asemoyeni, osukwini olukhethayo: i-Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 cishe ngamamitha angu-30 nge-pixel ne-VIIRS cishe ngamamitha angu-250. Akudingeki ukhiye we-API. Izithombe azicacile ngokwanele ukubona imigwaqo noma ujantshi.
org.mobsimlab.nasa-gibs.The whole world each day at about 250 m: Umhlaba wonke nsuku zonke cishe ngamamitha angu-250 nge-pixel (amamitha angu-306 kule mephu), namafu: okwesimo sesifunda kuphela.

org.mobsimlab.noise.Estimated noise of the service lines (AD: Umsindo olinganiselwe wemigqa yesevisi (ADR-0038): ibhande lomsindo elibukhoma ngenkathi udweba imigqa yasemgwaqweni nojantshi, nokuhlolwa kokukhala kwamajika, amabhuloho nezishintshi. Ukukhishwa komgwaqo nojantshi kwe-CNOSSOS-EU, endaweni evulekile ngaphandle kwezakhiwo okwamanje.
org.mobsimlab.noise.L_den and L_night of the drawn lines at: I-L_den ne-L_night yemigqa edwetshiwe ngamamitha angu-4, endaweni evulekile: amabanga ebhande nhlangothi zombili, igridi yabamukeli bemephu nokuhlolwa.

org.mobsimlab.ogc-layers.Map layers from WMS, WMTS and XYZ tile s: Izendlalelo zebalazwe ezivela kumasevisi amathayela e-WMS, WMTS ne-XYZ, njengamamephu ayisisekelo noma izendlalelo ezingaphezulu. UMphathi wengeza isevisi ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuphatha → Ama-plugin, nemininingwane yayo yokungena uma kudingeka; amathayela adlula kule MobSimLab, ngakho iziphequluli azilokothi ziyibone.

org.mobsimlab.on-demand-bus.Demand-responsive transport drawn with t: Ezokuthutha eziphendula isidingo ezidwetshwa ngethuluzi lendawo yesevisi: dweba indawo, setha izicelo ngehora, izimoto namahora esevisi, bese uthola izimoto ezidingekayo, isikhathi esimaphakathi sokulinda, sohambo nesokusuka emnyango kuya emnyango ngamafomula okulinganisa okuqhubekayo. Ukulingisa usuku kuthumela konke ukubhuka uhambo ngohambo (ADR-0042). Indawo iyabonakala kumhleli wohambo.
org.mobsimlab.on-demand-bus.Minibuses booked by app: outline the zon: Amabhasi amancane abhukwa ngohlelo lokusebenza: dweba indawo, setha izimoto namahora.

org.mobsimlab.panoramax.Photos shared by people and public bodie: Izithombe ezabiwe ngabantu nezikhungo zikahulumeni, ngaphansi kwamalayisense avulekile (ikakhulukazi i-CC BY-SA 4.0 noma i-Etalab 2.0) avumela ukwenza amamephu ngazo. Bonga umthwebuli uma usebenzisa esisodwa.
org.mobsimlab.panoramax.Street-level photos from Panoramax, the: Izithombe zezinga lomgwaqo ezivela ku-Panoramax, ingcebo yomphakathi yamahhala nevulekile yezithombe zemigwaqo. Vula Izithombe zemigwaqo emephini ukuze ubone lapho izithombe zathathwa khona, bese uchofoza iphoyinti ukuze ubone izithombe ezathathwa eduze kwalo. Izithombe zingaphansi kwamalayisense avulekile avumela ukwenza amamephu ngazo. Akudingeki ukhiye. Izithombe zidlula kule MobSimLab futhi azigcinwa noma zilondolozwe nephrojekthi.

org.mobsimlab.people-mover.Cable-hauled automated people movers on: Izithuthi zabagibeli ezizenzakalelayo ezidonswa ngentambo emzileni ophakeme, ezidwetshwa ngethuluzi lezikhala eziqondile: eziya ziphindela ezinezitimela ezimbili, nezindingilizi ezicindezelwe ezinezitimela ezikhumulekayo ezima kuzo zonke iziteshi (ADR-0037 §7). Ezizihambisayo zidinga umhleli kajantshi futhi zizofika kamuva.
org.mobsimlab.people-mover.Cable-hauled shuttles and loops on a gui: Eziya ziphindela nezindingilizi ezidonswa ngentambo emzileni: chofoza iziteshi, izinsika ziyalandela.
org.mobsimlab.people-mover.Shuttle, two trains on a fixed rope: Eya iphindela, izitimela ezimbili entanjeni engagudluki
